title: Permission required to create Space file tree root is unspecified
description: The permission table gives send-level members the right to create files and directories, but creating the root FileNode (role: urn:jmap:chat:filenode:space) is a one-time structural operation. The spec says creation is 'subject to permission' without saying which permission. A send-level member probably should not be able to establish the root. Add an explicit rule.
